detail: Train uses only 2014 months, validation uses only 2015 months, and all months after 2015 are treated as future test months.
Initial detector, semantic SVD, initial clusters, and XAI background are fit on train only.
Only validation months are used for hyperparameter selection.
Test months are consumed chronologically and are never used to tune parameters.
These are the same Proposed parameters tuned by exp_06_proposed.py through tune_on_val().
AUC-PR is used for validation selection because malware detection is class-imbalanced.

setting: Macro-F1, AUC-PR, AUC-ROC, FPR@TPR=90%, label_update_ratio, runtime
detail: Accuracy alone is intentionally excluded from the main claim because it is base-rate sensitive.
Cluster assignment and drift monitoring use unlabeled monthly features/scores; labels are used only for evaluation and selected update samples.
